---
title: "Coding Sandbox"
subtitle: "Write Python to build a graph and watch the visualization update"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
---

This page uses a Pyodide-powered Python editor to build a graph and immediately redraws the graph in the browser. The visualization and toolbar should match the standalone Sandbox page; this document adds the Python editor as an input step alongside the same graph canvas.

The editor supports a small NetworkX-like API and keeps the graph and code editor in sync automatically:

- `G = nx.Graph()`
- `G.add_node(name)`
- `G.add_edge(u, v)`
- `G.add_edge(u, v, weight=...)` (positional weight is also accepted)


```{python}
#| echo: false
default_python_code = """
G = nx.Graph()
G.add_node("Bob")
G.add_node("Carol")
G.add_node("Eve")
G.add_node("Frank")
G.add_edge("Bob", "Eve", weight = 3)
G.add_edge("Eve", "Frank")
G.add_edge("Frank", "Carol")

"""

ojs_define(sb_default_code = default_python_code)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { GraphEngine } from "./js/graph-engine.js";
import { mountGraphView } from "./js/graph-view.js";
import { PyGraphEngine } from "./js/py-graph-engine.js";
import { PythonEditorInput } from "./js/python-editor-input.js";

sandboxData = ({ nodes: [], edges: [] });
sandboxEngine = new GraphEngine(sandboxData, { directed: false });
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sandboxView = mountGraphView(sandboxEngine, document.querySelector("#sandbox-graph"), {
  width: 760,
  height: 460,
});
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
setupEditor = (() => {
  let editor = document.querySelector("[data-role='python-editor']");
  if (editor) {
    editor.value = sb_default_code;
  }

  let pyEngine = new PyGraphEngine({});
  let graphDisplayAdapter = {
    setGraph(graphJSON) {
      for (const id of Array.from(sandboxEngine.nodes.keys())) {
        sandboxEngine.deleteNode(id);
      }
      for (const n of graphJSON.nodes || []) {
        sandboxEngine.addNode({ id: n.id, label: n.label ?? n.id });
      }
      for (const e of graphJSON.edges || []) {
        if (!sandboxEngine.nodes.has(e.source)) sandboxEngine.addNode({ id: e.source, label: e.source });
        if (!sandboxEngine.nodes.has(e.target)) sandboxEngine.addNode({ id: e.target, label: e.target });
        sandboxEngine.addEdge({
          source: e.source,
          target: e.target,
          label: e.label ?? "",
          weight: e.weight !== undefined ? e.weight : 1,
        });
      }
    },
    toJSON() {
      const snap = sandboxEngine.snapshot();
      return {
        nodes: snap.nodes.map((n) => ({ id: n.id, label: n.label })),
        edges: snap.edges.map((e) => ({
          source: e.source,
          target: e.target,
          label: e.label,
          weight: e.weight,
        })),
      };
    },
  };

  let pythonRoot = document.querySelector("#python-editor-root");
  let pythonInput = null;
  if (pythonRoot) {
    pythonInput = PythonEditorInput.mount(pythonRoot, {
      graphDisplay: graphDisplayAdapter,
      engine: pyEngine,
    });
    pythonInput.start();
  }

  return pythonInput;
})();
```
